criteria.architecture: complete frontal P101 with full dark outer frame, narrow inner jamb, one high horizontal seam with two metallic end caps, exactly three right-side hinges, and one tall left-side smart lock
criteria.framing: complete frame visible with target 0-8 px visually white margin; up to 11 px accepted only with more than 98% assembly coverage
criteria.branding: NO_LOGO: zero logo, brand, badge, plaque, text, microtext, pseudo-writing, letters, numbers, icons, or symbol-like marks
criteria.lock: smart-lock face and handle remain blank and unlabelled; physical bevels and handle outlines are not display marks
criteria.scene: plain white catalog background; no room, wall, floor, perspective, props, watermark, or decorative border
criteria.derivation: direct built-in ImageGen output; no filter, recolor, mask, crop, resize, composite, retouch, or local repair

marginDetection.method: First pixel with any RGB channel below 245, measured from each canvas edge; measurement only, no crop

assets.note: Top margin uses the <=11 px exception; measured non-white assembly covers 98.18% of width and 99.48% of height.

rejected.reason: Rejected because both lateral visually white margins measured 12 px, above the 11 px exception. It is excluded from the active set and must never be promoted.

notes: The ten accepted PNGs remain untouched raw built-in ImageGen results. QA contact sheets are derived review artifacts only and are not promotable assets. No conversion or public promotion was performed.
